description: Submit a publicly reachable audio/video URL for speech-to-text transcription (optionally with diarization, translation, and summarization). ASYNC: returns a job id immediately — poll speechmatics_get_job until status is "done", then call speechmatics_get_transcript. Batch API: POST /jobs.

additional_vocab.description: Custom vocabulary — strings, or objects like {"content":"gnocchi","sounds_like":["nyohki"]}.

diarization.description: Speaker labeling: speaker (who spoke) | channel (per audio channel) | none.

enable_entities.description: Emit formatted entities (numbers, dates) in results.

fetch_auth_headers.description: Auth headers to send when fetching a private URL, e.g. ["Authorization: Bearer xyz"].

language.description: Transcription language code, e.g. en, es, de, fr.

notification_url.description: Webhook URL to POST the transcript to when the job completes.

operating_point.description: Accuracy/speed tradeoff. enhanced is more accurate; standard is faster/cheaper.

output_locale.description: Output spelling locale, e.g. en-US, en-GB.

summarize.description: If true, also produce a summary of the transcript.

translation_target_languages.description: Language codes to also translate the transcript into, e.g. ["es","de"].

url.description: Publicly reachable audio/video URL for Speechmatics to fetch and transcribe.

name: speechmatics_transcribe_url
title: Transcribe audio/video from URL
